title: The Inside Story of Udemy's Rise | Eren Bali
description:
Udemy founder Eren Bali shares an inside look at Udemy's path from startup to unicorn. He reveals key lessons on solving the marketplace chicken and egg problem, making critical early decisions, fundraising tips, avoiding common founder mistakes, and what VCs really look for in startups. Gain valuable insights from Eren's first-hand experience growing Udemy into a global online learning platform.

Co-founder and CEO of Udemy Eren Bali tells the foundation story of Udemy 

ABOUT SPEAKER

Eren Bali is an entrepreneur, CEO, and co-founder of Carbon Health, for 9 years and counting he has also served as a co-founder and CEO of Udemy.
